entities.summary: Organized collective efforts to achieve political change through mass mobilization, ideology, and sustained action. From the English Parliamentarians and French Revolutionaries to 20th-century independence movements, political movements have been the primary engines of democratic expansion, decolonization, and political transformation worldwide.
